note: [L] proves monotonicity of `G t + 2.50637/t` (the form `at + b/t`), not of `a + b/t`; no `qe^m ≥ 27` condition is needed since `div_totient_lt` is for `r ≥ 3`. Text typo, confirmed by two skeptics and `scripts/checks/steps/lemma_12_2_1_step_5.py`.

-- monotonicity of `t ↦ G t + c/t`
  set t₁ := Real.log (thetaN x) with ht₁
  set t₂ := Real.log (Real.log r) with ht₂
  have ht₁0 : 1.386 ≤ t₁ := by
    have : Real.log 4 ≤ t₁ := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hθ4
    have e : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
    have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    linarith
  have ht₁₂ : t₁ ≤ t₂ := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hθr
  have hG := exp_gamma_ge
  have hmono : G * t₁ + 2.50637 / t₁ ≤ G * t₂ + 2.50637 / t₂ := by
    have ht0 : 0 < t₁ := by linarith
    have ht0' : 0 < t₂ := by linarith
    have e : G * t₂ + 2.50637 / t₂ - (G * t₁ + 2.50637 / t₁) =
        (t₂ - t₁) * (G - 2.50637 / (t₁ * t₂)) := by field_simp; ring
    have h1 : 2.50637 / (t₁ * t₂) ≤ 1.625 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    have : 0 ≤ (t₂ - t₁) * (G - 2.50637 / (t₁ * t₂)) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    linarith

proof_context.conclusion: `hmono`: `G t₁ + 2.50637/t₁ ≤ G t₂ + 2.50637/t₂` for `1.386 ≤ t₁ ≤ t₂` (`G ≥ 1.625`), i.e. the function `t ↦ at + b/t` is increasing; this is the monotonicity step passing from `n` to `x`.
